description: Danish speech recognition with a rotary Whisper encoder and Qwen3 decoder.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: auto preserves silence splitting above 30 seconds; silence splits above the configured duration at silence boundaries; fixed splits at the configured duration; none disables splitting and accepts at most 30 seconds.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Maximum chunk duration when splitting. In auto mode the 30-second trigger remains unchanged.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated tokens per chunk, also capped to eight tokens per audio second plus twelve.

request.name: num_beams
request.description: Beam-search width. One selects greedy decoding.

request.name: length_penalty
request.description: Exponent used to normalize beam scores by generated length.

request.name: cased
request.description: Request casing separately from punctuation. Both cased and punc must be provided to override automatic formatting.

request.name: punc
request.description: Request punctuation only, unlike the combined punctuation/casing control in Canary, Cohere and original Hviske. Both cased and punc must be provided to override automatic formatting.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Weight storage override; native preserves the supplied checkpoint types.

description.en: Danish speech recognition with a rotary Whisper encoder and Qwen3 decoder.
description.zh: 丹麦语语音识别，采用旋转位置编码的 Whisper 编码器与 Qwen3 解码器。

audio_chunk_mode.en: auto preserves silence splitting above 30 seconds; silence splits above the configured duration at silence boundaries; fixed splits at the configured duration; none disables splitting and accepts at most 30 seconds.
audio_chunk_mode.zh: auto 在超过 30 秒时按静音切分；silence 在配置时长以上的静音边界切分；fixed 按配置时长切分；none 关闭切分并最多接受 30 秒。

audio_chunk_duration_sec.en: Maximum chunk duration when splitting. In auto mode the 30-second trigger remains unchanged.
audio_chunk_duration_sec.zh: 切分时的最大分块时长。auto 模式下 30 秒触发阈值保持不变。

max_tokens.en: Maximum generated tokens per chunk, also capped to eight tokens per audio second plus twelve.
max_tokens.zh: 每个分块生成的最大 token 数，同时限制为每秒音频 8 个 token 加 12。

num_beams.en: Beam-search width. One selects greedy decoding.
num_beams.zh: beam search 宽度；1 表示贪心解码。

length_penalty.en: Exponent used to normalize beam scores by generated length.
length_penalty.zh: 用于按生成长度归一化 beam 分数的指数。

cased.en: Request casing separately from punctuation. Both cased and punc must be provided to override automatic formatting.
cased.zh: 单独请求大小写，与标点分开。cased 与 punc 必须同时提供才能覆盖自动格式。

punc.en: Request punctuation only, unlike the combined punctuation/casing control in Canary, Cohere and original Hviske. Both cased and punc must be provided to override automatic formatting.
punc.zh: 仅请求标点，不同于 Canary、Cohere 与原版 Hviske 的标点/大小写联合控制。cased 与 punc 必须同时提供才能覆盖自动格式。
